newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Business group applauds HK 1997/98 budget.
newsitem.headline: Business group applauds HK 1997/98 budget.

text.p: Hong Kong's transitional budget provides a sound fiscal and economic background for the territory's handover to China on July 1, the Hong Kong General Chamber of Commerce said on Wednesday.

"The 1997/98 budget always had the potential to be a difficult one, but consultation and cooperation through the expert group of the Joint Liaison Group has produced a result conservative in its approach, but acceptable to most in the community," said Chamber chairman James Tien.
Tien said the budget, presented by Financial Secretary Donald Tsang on Wednesday, was well-executed and a "sound basis for confidence."
The budget was prepared by a committee under the auspices of the Sino-British Joint Liaison Group overseeing the handover.
